body: /cc @cescoffier, as I believe this falls under `area/vertx`.

Looking at `EventBusConsumer#implementInvoke`, it appears that `T` checks for multiple return types:
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/2cbd177416f92b9f45abb34b6f01acb8cb0f4eb5/extensions/vertx/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/vertx/deployment/EventBusConsumer.java#L176-L187

However `Message<T>` only checks for a void return type:
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/2cbd177416f92b9f45abb34b6f01acb8cb0f4eb5/extensions/vertx/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/vertx/deployment/EventBusConsumer.java#L161-L165

Is `Message<T>` only working with void return types deliberate?

Well, the javadoc of `@ConsumeEvent` is pretty clear that _"If it accepts `io.vertx.core.eventbus.Message` then the return type must be void"_, i.e. you should call the `Message.reply()` method directly. However, I'm not sure why the return type is not validated during build.

issue.title: Vertx - validate the return type of an event consumer method

body:
> Well, the javadoc of [@ConsumeEvent](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/75536aeaf79fad44452f19b6077958eb047c06b4/extensions/vertx/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/vertx/ConsumeEvent.java) is pretty clear that "If it accepts io.vertx.core.eventbus.Message then the return type must be void", i.e. you should call the Message.reply() method directly. 

_Ahh_ — IntelliJ's been having issues displaying sources, so I must have missed this.

So I guess the questions are:
1. Can Quarkus validate the return type on build? (I see you've already opened a PR)
2. If `Message` cannot return `Uni<T>` for logical reasons, is it possible to inject both the [ `Message#headers`](https://vertx.io/docs/apidocs/io/vertx/core/eventbus/Message.html#headers--) and the body instead? I'm happy to open a PR for this, provided it's possible for `@ConsumeEvent` to work with 2 parameter types.

About 1 - well, @mkouba is fast!
About 2 - yes, we could inject the message header as parameter.

issue.title: Vertx - Allow @ConsumeEvent methods to receive message headers
